It leverages localization similarity (LocSim) and identity consistency (IdSim) to penalize both false negatives and mismatches. The homography localization maps image-space coordinates to physical court space, grounding tracking in real-world geometry. Tracklet integration uses Jensen-Shannon divergence to merge appearance and motion cues, forming robust player identities over time. These primitives collectively enable precise, interpretable tracking in structured environments like 3x3 basketball, where player identification and spatial behavior are critical.
